_note: The third document read page by page in this repository, and the first read for a name that was previously carried entirely from the research note. It exists because data/universe.json recorded this operator at 36 MW live, and the company's own annual report does not support that figure. Everything here is PRIMARY and cites the printed page it was read from. The report is laid out as two page spreads, so one PDF page carries two printed pages; the offset note in the manifest records how they were separated.

payables.bucketLimitNote: The shortest overdue bucket the table prints covers everything up to a year, and the appointed day under the Act is 45 days. The bucket is therefore coarser than the statute, and cannot show that every rupee passed the appointed day. What the five clauses report is that none of it did.
